summary: Recent crime data from Boise State University indicates a concerning uptick in incidents, particularly in violent offenses such as battery and sexual assault. Notably, there were multiple reports of sexual battery and related offenses occurring within a short time frame, highlighting a potential pattern that warrants further investigation. In contrast, incidents like hit-and-runs and property damage have seen a mix of closed and open cases, suggesting varying levels of resolution. Compared to previous months, the current data reflects an increase in serious offenses, particularly around the beginning of March, which may require heightened awareness and preventive measures on campus.
